title: mcp/list_frontier/v2
description: The result of the list_frontier tool (F09-R9; D-28). v2 (mcpfix WA2, the owner's ruling of 2026-11-25): compact and paged by default — one row per target with open work, or one target's entries with target_id; full: true is GET /frontier.json exactly, as v1 answered always. Or an error result naming the source that did not answer (R10).

oneOf.description: full: true — frontier.json with the live claim overlay (GET /frontier.json), exactly; the filters and target_id, when given, keep the entries that match.
The default: one row per target with open nodes, in the index's order, in pages (mcpfix WA2).

rendered_from.description: The commit the frontier was rendered from.

count.description: How many rows there are in all, across every page.

limit.description: The most rows this page could hold.

cursor.description: Where this page starts, as the call gave it; null for the first page.

next.description: The cursor of the page after this one; null on the last page.

root.description: The target's root statement, from targets/index.json; null when the index does not list the target yet.

track.description: open or formalization (D-6), from the index; null when it has none.

status.description: The target's status from the index (listed, active, resolved, dormant, known-result).

open.description: How many of the target's nodes are frontier entries (matching the filters, when given).

claimable.description: How many of those entries may be claimed.

oneOf.description: With target_id: that target's frontier entries, in the file's order, in pages (mcpfix WA2).

rendered_from.description: The commit the frontier was rendered from.

count.description: How many rows there are in all, across every page.

limit.description: The most rows this page could hold.

cursor.description: Where this page starts, as the call gave it; null for the first page.

next.description: The cursor of the page after this one; null on the last page.

entries.description: Frontier entries as GET /frontier.json carries them.

oneOf.description: The plain path did not answer, or the arguments were refused (F09-R10)
